results.output: Lucid Sentence is a complimentary, open-source word processor designed for .docx files. It retains the familiar ribbon interface of Microsoft Word, enabling users already proficient with Word to locate all commands, while introducing a contemporary aesthetic through meticulous typography. The editor is accessible on desktop, Android, and as a web application on iPhone and iPad. Optional on-device artificial intelligence can rewrite selections, correct grammar, summarize content, and translate plain-language requests into ribbon commands; however, the document remains entirely within the user's environment. Every AI modification is presented as a suggestion, allowing the writer to accept or reject it, ensuring the document is never altered without their explicit consent.
The team went to the meeting yesterday, and they were very happy with their results. It was a good outcome.

Lucid Sentence is a free, open-source word processor for .docx files that keeps Word's familiar ribbon while adding a fresher look with careful typography. It also offers optional on-device AI to rewrite selections, fix grammar, and summarize without sending the document anywhere.
